title: Review snapshot (D26)
description: Written by the pipeline to review/snapshot.json at the end of every run (fast or full). What a review UI (the review Function, #9) shows. Read-only: decisions go back as review events (event.schema.json). Timestamps are UTC with a Z suffix; fields ending in _pt or holding pt-PT text (price, dates, found_on, checked_at) are display strings already formatted in Europe/Lisbon.

approve_max_age_hours.description: The pipeline refuses an approve event whose live_check.checked_at (else created_at) is older than this when it applies it ('Aprovação com mais de 24 h: verifica o preço outra vez.'). A UI should warn before then and offer a fresh check; reject and published events have no age limit.

queue.description: Waiting for review: status rendered or new, newest first.

approved.description: Approved, waiting to be published, newest first.

closed.description: Most recent expired or rejected deals.

pending_events.description: Decisions written but not yet applied to the database this snapshot came from, oldest first. A UI shows them as pending and should not offer another decision for the same deal.

recent_outcomes.description: What happened to the latest applied events, newest first (refusals carry the pt-PT reason).

url.description: WebP on the public site: only for deals the site shows (approved, published, expired after approval).

key.description: WebP copy in the object store for deals still open for review (new, rendered, approved); the review Function serves it behind Access.

observation_id.description: price_observations.id the price comes from (traceability, D2).

headline.description: 'Lisboa → Paris (Beauvais)': names a remote arrival airport.

transfers.description: Stops on the way out, from the deal's observation (null: unknown). Optional (added within v1): the review Function's live check applies the route's max_transfers to it like the pipeline; without it, it falls back to `direct`.

return_transfers.description: Stops on the way back, as `transfers`.

gate.description: The agency selling the offer, from the Aviasales GraphQL row matched to it (D39); null when no row matched. Optional (added within v1).

with_baggage.description: A checked bag is included (D39): from the matched GraphQL row only, null = unknown. Optional (added within v1).

baggage.description: The pt-PT baggage line ('com mala de porão incluída' / 'só bagagem de mão') the captions and slides print, null when unknown: a UI prints nothing then. Optional (added within v1).

found_date.description: When a traveller found the price (provider cache).

fetched_at.description: When our collection first saw it.

caption.description: Instagram caption as rendered (carries the disclosure).

whatsapp_text.description: Ready-to-paste pt-PT WhatsApp text (D32) for approved and published promotions with a partner link: headline (names a remote arrival airport), price, dates, airline, arrival airport, found date vs checked time (Lisbon), the stored affiliate_url and the disclosure. Null for any other status. A UI shows it with a copy button.

page_url.description: The promotion page on the public site, for deals the site shows.

last_checked_at.description: Last recheck by the pipeline (collection or `deal check`).

query.description: Exact query of the provider request (prices_for_dates) that prices this trip now; the API token goes in the X-Access-Token header.

rules.description: Same recheck rule as the pipeline: valid while the same departure and return dates are offered at the deal price or lower, within the route rules, found within max_offer_age_days.
